Merrett turning out in our colours once again, and although he lost the 100 by inches to the local runner, Buchanan, he made amends by winning the 220 yards.

Alan Jackson had a fine win from Buchanan (HHH) in the 300 yards after having finished third, with 10.6 secs., in the short sprint. John Thresher and Dereck Crookes gave us max. points in the Senior ¾ mile, and with some doubling up in other events we eventually amassed 60 points, as follows:
He beat Grice, Mouat, Stock and Buchanan in good time. JOHN is all set for an even better track season than 1967, when he recorded 8:57.6 for 3,000 metres steeplechase.

In the 5000m Laurie O'Hara sat in on Buchanan of Hillingdon until the final 80 metres when he leapt to the fore with his customary burst but surprise, surprise, the Hillingdon runner had more in hand and with a grin regained the lead, leaving Laurie with 2nd.
Both gave of their best but failed to hold the much more experienced Brighton pair of O'Shea and Buchanan who finished 2nd and 3rd. Our pair, with times of 11:01 and 12:31, finished 5th and 10th.
